description: A query language where the client asks one endpoint for exactly the fields it needs. Flexible for clients, demanding for servers (resolvers, N+1, cost limits).
The client calls server procedures with types inferred from the server code, without a hand-written contract. TypeScript-only, best in a monorepo.
Contract-first RPC with Protocol Buffers over HTTP/2 and generated clients in many languages. Common between internal services.
An API layer shaped for one client's screens, aggregating several services so the frontend makes one request.
An HTTP request another system sends to your endpoint when an event happens. Requires signature verification, fast acknowledgment and idempotent processing.
A machine-readable description of a REST API, used to generate docs, clients and tests in any language.
